purpose: Iterate completion review using outcome requirements and time-indexed observational evidence.
development: All 88 WebArena development traces; inspect failures and retain every iteration, including regressions.
regression: 310 WebArena former test traces already inspected. These are NOT a new held-out evaluation.
transfer: 20 previously uninspected WorkArena official test tasks: first 8 L1 and first 12 L2 sorted by SHA256('quality-gate-v3:' + task_id); include all available annotated actors. Freeze final implementation before evaluating. Report environmental shift and small sample limitations.
invariant: Initial WebJudge acceptances remain unchanged. Review rejections only. Human labels never enter inference. No task IDs, site-specific answer dictionaries or gold strings in the method.
iterations: Outcome-only task contract plus per-condition evidence coverage and exact quote validation
Development-error-driven refinement and optional independent contradiction check
comparison: Historical WebJudge and reread controls, plus same-evidence unanchored reread. Keep model alias, temperature, input evidence limits and output cap fixed within each paired run. Disclose cached baseline date and service alias rather than claim immutable weights.
primary: Additional human successes recovered AND additional human failures accepted, with raw counts, recall, FPR, paired task bootstrap and token costs including contract extraction and unsuccessful attempts.
selection: Select on development only: zero new false acceptances, then greatest rescued successes, then lower logical token cost. A failed guard must be stated; do not silently relabel or omit trajectories.
budget: Existing budgeted model client; separate 30 USD conservative ceiling for this workstream. Fixed 1300 output token cap, temperature 0, DeepSeek Flash alias.
stop: Two or three concrete development iterations, then freeze and report regression/transfer without tuning to either. No guaranteed gain. Preserve all previous evidence.
